item.title: Ex-Together Church pastor Micahn Carter to launch new church while fighting rape allegation
item.description: Former megachurch pastor Micahn Carter and his wife, April, have announced plans to start a new church in Indianapolis, Indiana, as he continues to pursue a defamation lawsuit against his former assistant, who alleges he raped her in a church office in 2019. #MicahnCarter #TogetherChurch #Launch #Rape

item.title: Food Network star Aarti Sequeira challenges Christians to rethink hosting as a ministry
item.description: Aarti Sequeira, winner of “The Next Food Network Star” and judge on the television show “Cooks vs. Cons,” shares why she believes hosting is foundational for Christians. #AartiSequeira #food #chef #TheNextFoodNetworkStar #MadetoShare

item.title: Archdiocese agrees to sell land under historic NYC luxury hotel for $490M to pay sex abuse victims
item.description: The Catholic Archdiocese of New York has agreed to sell the land it currently owns beneath the historic Lotte New York Palace Hotel—New York’s first five-star hotel—for $490 million dollars to help pay survivors of priest sex abuse. #CardinalTimothyDolan #NewYorkArchdiocese #childsexabuse #survivors

item.title: Providence police releases image of person who might help them catch Brown University shooter
item.description: Authorities have released an enhanced image of an individual they are asking to speak with as they continue to search for the suspect who fatally shot two Brown University students and wounded nine others. #BrownUniversity #police #Providence #shooting #EllaCook #MukhammadAzizUmurzokov

item.title: 5 highlights from Trump's year-end address
item.description: In his year-end speech at the White House on Wednesday night, President Donald Trump reflected on the first 11 months of his second term and offered a vision for 2026 as the country heads into a midterm election year and Americans continue to deal with inflation. #DonaldTrump #WhiteHouse #Illegalimmigration #Tariffs #Drugs #WarriorDividend #TrumpRX

item.title: 'I believe in Hell': Kirk Cameron clarifies position on eternal damnation, announces plans for roundtable discussion
item.description: Actor and evangelist Kirk Cameron has responded to controversy surrounding a recent discussion on the doctrine of hell, emphasizing that he fully believes in Hell, judgment, and conscious suffering — but is openly questioning whether that suffering is eternal. #KirkCameron #Hell #RayComfort

item.title: Missionary pilot remains missing 2 months after kidnapping in Niger
item.description: Nearly two months since American missionary pilot Kevin Rideout was kidnapped from his home in the highly secure Château 1 neighborhood of Niamey in the capital of Niger in West Africa, local Christians say they are worried about the silence around efforts to rescue him. #KevinRideout #Niger #Pilot #Missionary #Kidnapped

item.title: Christian prisoners released in Eritrea, but many remain jailed after years without charges: Open Doors
item.description: Several Christians were among a group of prisoners recently released in Eritrea, though seven senior church leaders remain in detention after two decades without charge or trial, a watchdog group has announced. #ChristiansinEritrea #JailedChristians #Persecution #OpenDoors #EritreanOrthodoxChurch

item.title: NASCAR champion Greg Biffle and family perish in fiery plane crash in NC
item.description: Just five days before he was supposed to celebrate his 56th birthday, former NASCAR driver Greg Biffle perished with his wife daughter and son if a fiery plane crash in North Carolina on Thursday. #NASCAR #GregBiffle #Crash

item.title: Police issue warrant for suspect in Brown U shooting; possible link to MIT murder
item.description: Authorities have issued an arrest warrant for a suspect in the Brown University shooting that resulted in the deaths of two students and nine others being wounded. #MIT #murder #BrownUniversity #shooter #suspect #FBI #shooting #EllaCook
